name: Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021
owner: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Rules governing intermediaries (social media, messaging platforms) including grievance officer requirements, traceability for significant social media intermediaries, and content moderation obligations.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (meity.gov.in) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (meity.gov.in).
